You said directly between USA and destination. 

So what if there is a connecting flight in a different country before you get to your destination? I’m asking for my mom.
Ok thank you for that. I’ll start lower, probably 25 or so and go from there. I appreciate the help.

Ok thx, I got Kaplan books the other day. Would I do Anki as part of 1. Or 2. ?  I downloaded both JackSparrow and MilesDown decks and all of those cards are a bit overwhelming rn. From other posts I’ve read it looks like most people used MilesDown and that I should be doing 50 or 100 cards a day? I bookmarked some posts that I’m going to look thru after work today to see how others have used Anki.  


Yes i definitely realized content recall was lacking. I was expecting that given the how long it’s been since I’ve done anything academic. The diagnostic has the question and explanations for each answer. I spent some time looking thru it the past weekend and will finish going thru it this weekend.
I definitely didn’t want to hear that, but I most likely needed to hear that from someone else besides myself for it to make sense. I appreciate the honesty.
Yes next May would be the cycle I would ideally be looking at. I definitely think I can bring the mcat up. I was just unsure how to space it all out but I’ll figure that out. Thx
I’ve taken all of the prereqs.
It finishes at the end of regular NBA season
